description: Send a single email over a connected Google/Microsoft mailbox (Settings → Connections). Provide to, subject and body. Set isHtml=false for plain text. Optionally cc/bcc and a provider ('google'/'microsoft' or a connection id; blank ⇒ first available).

body.description: Email body (HTML by default; set isHtml=false for plain text).

provider.description: Which mailbox to send from: 'google'/'microsoft' or a connection id. Blank ⇒ first available.

name: gambot_send_email
title: Send email
